lines.say: 63 tokens / become 20, / and the fix / stays the same.
Caveman makes / your AI agent / say less / and read less.
It started as a joke / in April 2026. / Now it is past / 100,000 stars.
Caveman is a voice, / not broken grammar. / It answers first / and drops the greeting. / Code and commands / stay untouched.
A normal agent / explains a React bug / in 63 tokens. / Caveman needs 20, / ultracave 14, / megacave 13.
Adobe Research found it / 1.4 to 2.4× cheaper. / JetBrains ran / 86 coding tasks / with no measurable / quality loss.
Then caveman grew / a proxy that shrinks / what the agent reads. / A 28,041-token CSV / drops to 314.
Across whole sessions, / input drops 33.2%, / and all 18 answers / stay right.

bars.note: session saved · HTML: 9.9% worse, no compressor yet

lines.say: Web pages shrink too. / A 200-row table / takes 121 tokens / instead of 15,704.
One line installs it / in Claude Code, Codex, / Cursor and 30+ more.
Send this to someone / whose agent / never stops talking.
Caveman save you token. / Star cost zero.
